svg.title: Block Jacobian coloring: fifteen seeds for a radius-two stencil
svg.desc: Ten point blocks with three variables each. The declared Jacobian band extends two blocks on either side. Scalar column colors repeat every fifteen columns. Columns zero and fifteen share a seed because their possible residual row supports do not overlap.
svg.text: A local stencil. A small set of directional seeds.
10 point blocks · 3 variables per block · radius r = 2
Column colors identify the differentiation seeds
L / R: algebraic endpoint traces; 1–8: physical cells
The row supports do not overlap.
Some allowed entries can still be zero.
Scalar colors: three variables in each of five repeating block families
